text_en: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.
text_cn: 到了第八天，梅瑟召集亚郎和他的儿子以及以色列的长老，

text_en: He said to Aaron, “Take a bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the Lord .
text_cn: 然后对亚郎说：“你牵一头公牛犊来，作为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊来，作为全燔祭，都应是无瑕的，牵到上主前。”

text_en: And say to the people of Israel, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; a calf and a lamb, yearlings without blemish, for a burnt offering;
text_cn: 又吩咐以色列子民说：“你们应牵一只公山羊来，作为赎罪祭；一头公牛犊和一只一岁的公羔羊来，都应是无瑕的，作为全燔祭；

text_en: and an ox and a ram for an offering of well-being to sacrifice before the Lord ; and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the Lord will appear to you. ’”
text_cn: 再牵一头公牛和一只公绵羊来，作为和平祭，祭献在上主面前；再带些油调的素祭祭品来，因为今天上主要显现给你们。”

text_en: They brought what Moses commanded to the front of the tent of meeting; and the whole congregation drew near and stood before the Lord .
text_cn: 他们遂将梅瑟所吩咐的，都带到会幕前；全会众都前来，站在上主面前。

text_en: And Moses said, “This is the thing that the Lord commanded you to do, so that the glory of the Lord may appear to you. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟遂说：“这是上主命你们做的事，好使上主的荣耀显现给你们。”

text_en: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and for the people; and sacrifice the offering of the people, and make atonement for them; as the Lord has commanded. ”
text_cn: 以后，梅瑟对亚郎说：“你走近祭坛，奉献你的赎罪祭和全燔祭，为你自己和你的家族赎罪；然后奉献人民的祭品，为他们赎罪，如上主所吩咐的。”

text_en: Aaron drew near to the altar, and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
text_cn: 亚郎于是走近祭坛，宰杀了那为自己作赎罪祭的公牛犊。

text_en: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar; and the rest of the blood he poured out at the base of the altar.
text_cn: 亚郎的儿子将血递给他，他把手指浸在血里，抹在祭坛的四角上，剩下的血都倒在祭坛脚旁。

text_en: But the fat, the kidneys, and the appendage of the liver from the sin offering he turned into smoke on the altar, as the Lord commanded Moses;
text_cn: 赎罪祭牺牲的脂肪、两肾和肝叶，都放在祭坛上焚烧，照上主对梅瑟吩咐的。

text_en: and the flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.
text_cn: 至于肉和皮，都在营外用火烧了。

text_en: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. Aaron’s sons brought him the blood, and he dashed it against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 然后亚郎宰杀了全燔祭牺牲，亚郎的儿子将血递给他，他将血洒在祭坛四周。

text_en: And they brought him the burnt offering piece by piece, and the head, which he turned into smoke on the altar.
text_cn: 以后，他们将切成块的全燔祭牺牲和头递给他，他就放在祭坛上焚烧。

text_en: He washed the entrails and the legs and, with the burnt offering, turned them into smoke on the altar.
text_cn: 内脏和腿洗净后，也放在祭坛上同全燔祭牺牲一起焚烧。

text_en: Next he presented the people’s offering. He took the goat of the sin offering that was for the people, and slaughtered it, and presented it as a sin offering like the first one.
text_cn: 随后他奉献了人民的祭品：将那为人民作赎罪祭的公山羊牵来，宰杀了，献作赎罪祭，如前一牺牲一样。

text_en: He presented the burnt offering, and sacrificed it according to regulation.
text_cn: 又奉献了全燔祭，全按礼仪进行；

text_en: He presented the grain offering, and, taking a handful of it, he turned it into smoke on the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.
text_cn: 又奉献了素祭，由其中取了一满把，放在祭坛上焚烧，这是早晨全燔祭以外的祭献。

text_en: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as a sacrifice of well-being for the people. Aaron’s sons brought him the blood, which he dashed against all sides of the altar,
text_cn: 最后，他宰杀了为人民作和平祭的公牛和公绵羊；亚郎的儿子将血递给他，他就将血洒在祭坛四周。

text_en: and the fat of the ox and of the ram—the broad tail, the fat that covers the entrails, the two kidneys and the fat on them, and the appendage of the liver.
text_cn: 至于牛羊的脂肪、肥尾、遮盖内脏的脂肪、两肾和肝叶，

text_en: They first laid the fat on the breasts, and the fat was turned into smoke on the altar;
text_cn: 他们都放在牺牲的胸脯上；亚郎遂将脂肪放在祭坛上焚烧，

text_en: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron raised as an elevation offering before the Lord , as Moses had commanded.
text_cn: 胸脯和右后腿，拿来在上主前行了奉献的摇礼，照梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them; and he came down after sacrificing the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the offering of well-being.
text_cn: 以后亚郎向人民举起手来，祝福了他们。当他献完了赎罪祭、全燔祭及和平祭以后，就由祭坛上下来了。

text_en: Moses and Aaron entered the tent of meeting, and then came out and blessed the people; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.
text_cn: 以后，梅瑟和亚郎走进了会幕，二人出来，祝福百姓时，上主的荣耀显现给全体百姓；

text_en: Fire came out from the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the fat on the altar; and when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.
text_cn: 由上主前出来了火，吞噬了祭坛上的全燔祭祭品和脂肪。全体百姓见了，齐声欢呼，俯伏在地。
